title: Soft delete and restore records

requirements.text: Deleting marks the record deleted (deleted_at, deleted_by) instead of removing the row
Default queries, search, counts and exports exclude soft-deleted records
An authorized user can restore a record within the retention window, intact with its relationships
Deleting, restoring and viewing the trash are authorized and never cross tenants
Unique constraints account for deleted rows, so a restore either succeeds or reports the conflict
Dependent records follow the parent's delete and restore consistently
Records past retention are permanently purged by an idempotent job

evidence.name: soft delete marks deleted_at, deleted_by and delete_batch instead of removing the row
schema applies; delete marks rows and the live view hides them
hidden by default: get, live lists, search and counts exclude soft-deleted records
schema applies; delete marks rows and the live view hides them from counts and search
restore within the retention window brings the record back intact with its children
restore after the retention window is refused with retention-expired
cascade by batch: restore brings back exactly the children deleted with the parent
authorization: delete, restore and the trash are authorized and never cross tenants
trash handler: list, restore, conflict body, auth, origin check and no-store
uniqueness: restore reports the conflict while a live row holds the unique value, then succeeds
partial unique index: a restore reports the conflict and changes nothing, then succeeds
an undeclared unique index violation on restore rolls back and reports conflict
cascade: children follow the parent's delete and restore; children deleted earlier stay in the trash
cascade by batch: restore brings back exactly the children deleted with the parent
purge: entries past retention are purged children first, and a second run purges nothing
purge removes expired rows children first under foreign keys, and a second run deletes 0
purge: a failing entry is kept and reported while later entries are still purged
purge keeps and reports an entry blocked by a live child under the real foreign key

notes: module:soft-delete covers every requirement for tables that follow its PostgreSQL pattern (deleted_at/deleted_by/delete_batch columns, partial unique indexes, live views). Hidden-by-default holds only for reads that use the live view, liveCondition() or a row-level security policy, and unique sets are per tenant. comments soft-deletes a comment as a tombstone (body cleared, replies kept) with no restore; durable-jobs can schedule purgeExpired.
